captures.description: THE TOOL, SIGNED OUT, 2026-11-01: 'OLMoTrace is the first real-time system that traces language model outputs back to multi-trillion-token training datasets. Developed by the Allen Institute for AI (Ai2) and winner of Best Demo at ACL 2025, it lets users inspect the exact training text that influenced a model's response.' How it works (verbatim matching, the infini-gram index, filtering by unigram probability and ranking by BM25, the three supported OLMo models); four use cases (fact-checking, hallucination diagnosis, creative tracing, arithmetic and memory analysis); pointers to the blog post and the arXiv listing; an embedded Ai2 video (2:17); an offer on the GitHub code or infini-gram indexing. Six cards: Ai2, arXiv, ACL Anthology (two), Hugging Face, YouTube.

atoms.evidence: OLMoTrace is the first real-time system that traces language model outputs back to multi-trillion-token training datasets.
Developed by the Allen Institute for AI (Ai2)
winner of Best Demo at ACL 2025
It tokenizes the model's generated text and scans for maximal matching word spans against a massive training corpus within seconds.
for open models like OLMo 2 32B Instruct, OLMo 2 13B Instruct, and OLMoE 1B 7B Instruct.
it lets users inspect the exact training text that influenced a model's response.
how to access the open-source code on GitHub
It uses an extended infini-gram suffix array index
